structured.fit: Multi-hot phrase vocabulary per channel on TRAIN items only
structured.similarity: Max over positive Support>=.7 of equal-weight channel cosine; missing channels0, no invented pyramid
structured.scope: Original Hybrid-only Top50, same .05 weak signal floor

calibration.support: 5 Train items by fixed ID hash; users selected by hash only
calibration.CDF: Train-only pseudoSupport score empirical mid-CDF, RAW MF to avoid clipping ties, original Content; alpha .25/.75 unchanged
calibration.gate: Train reference MF clip fraction>.01 OR MF/Content std ratio outside[.5,2]; finite nonzero references required
calibration.constant_fallback: Original bounded component if fitted reference range<=1e-12

design: Three predeclared policies, no hyperparameter search. Diagnostic eligibility gates use only training/reference features, not Outer answer accuracy. Reused developer5fold selection bias explicitly acknowledged instead of expensive nested search
background: Diagnose existing V32 fold models without fitting or changing them; evaluate ONLY the selected promising fixed new policy alongside that scope baseline, no selection across scopes
selection: Mean positive-user fold NDCG then Recall then HitRate; strict improvement over baseline required, ties retain baseline. No claim of best-ever historical algorithm
artifact: 5-fold bank, default_fold1 fixed before results, no ensemble/all50 or305 refit
reserved25: No rating decoding/evaluation or V24/V31 final-result reads
